answer: Clique Delta Pricing.** Each agent must declare its full interaction neighborhood before transacting; the protocol charges for the size of the symmetric difference (delta) between declared and observed partners, priced per novel edge. Honest agents form stable clusters and pay near zero, while a sybil farm must either reveal its whole reef of fake links up front or pay escalating edge fees each epoch. A random-looking link pattern raises cost per identity above any plausible reward, and cluster overlap is logged in a shared crystal so duplication across identities is detected.
